name: Commission-free freelance portfolio and payments (Contra)
summary: Show a portfolio, find or bring your own clients, and get paid without Contra taking a commission from your earnings.
whatYouDo: You build a portfolio profile, apply to opportunities or invite your own clients, and handle proposals, contracts and invoices through Contra. Clients pay through the platform, and you withdraw to a payout method such as PayPal or Payoneer.
appeal: No commission on freelancer earnings (Contra has been commission-free since 2021)
Handy for invoicing clients you find yourself
Portfolio-centred profiles suit designers and other creatives
Most payouts arrive within minutes (Contra help)
watchOuts: Clients pay platform fees ($29 per one-off invoice or contract, or $29/month for ongoing projects) unless you have Contra Pro, which may put some clients off
Payout fees: 2% to PayPal, or a flat $3 to Payoneer plus Payoneer's own charges
Third-party sources say Contra Pro costs about $29/month and some features need it
It's not mainly a job board, so you still have to find clients
Payout options for Canada weren't confirmed in this check

compensation.notes: You set your rates, and no earnings data was found. Contra takes no commission, but payout and client-side fees apply.

reliability.notes: No data on how much work new freelancers find on Contra.

fees: No commission on freelancer earnings. Clients pay $29 per one-off invoice or contract, or $29/month per ongoing project (waived on invoices from Contra Pro members). Payouts cost 2% to PayPal or $3 to Payoneer. Contra Pro is about $29/month (third-party figure).
applicationSteps: Create a Contra profile and add portfolio projects
Find opportunities or invite your existing clients
Send proposals, contracts or invoices through Contra
Withdraw payments to an available payout method (check what's offered in Canada)
fitsIf: You already have, or can find, clients, especially for design or creative work, and want to avoid marketplace commissions.
notFitIf: You need a platform to bring you steady work, or your clients won't accept platform fees.
